review_candidates.title: IT Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: Description Mountain Land Physical Therapy runs roughly 80 outpatient clinics, and every one of them depends on technology working. We are hiring an on-site IT Support Specialist to be the person our clinical and administrative teams reach when something is not working, and to make sure it gets fixed. This is a real first-line support role. You will take requests by phone, email, and ticket, work through them, and close them out. You will replace hardware, set up laptops and phones for new hires, help clinics get printers and payment terminals working, and travel out to locations when something needs hands on it. Some days that means solving the same problem five times. Other days it means driving to a clinic and being the reason they can see patients that afternoon. We are more interested in how you think and whether people can count on you than in how long your resume is. If you have certifications and help desk experience, great. If you are early in your career, technically curious, and the kind of person who follows through without being reminded, we would like to talk to you. This is the entry point into our IT team, not a dead end. The people who do well here take ownership of problems, get curious about how the systems actually work, and grow into systems administration, automation, and security work. We will support that, and there is real room for it as the company grows. What You'll Do Take in support requests, prioritize them, work them, and document what you did. Fix issues at the desktop and device level, including software installs, hardware swaps, and configuration. Set up equipment and accounts for new hires, and make sure access is removed when people leave. Support clinic technology including workstations, printers, phones, tablets, and payment terminals. Travel to clinics for hardware replacements, installs, and issues that cannot be fixed remotely. Escalate the things that need deeper technical involvement, and learn from how they get solved. Keep asset records accurate and write up the fixes that other people will need later. What We're Looking For An aptitude for troubleshooting Windows and Microsoft 365, and a willingness to learn quickly. Comfort with basic computer hardware, including PCs, printers, and peripherals. Genuinely good communication. You will be talking to therapists and front office staff, not engineers. Dependability. Clinics need to know their request is being handled. A valid driver's license and willingness to travel to clinic locations. Comfort working around protected health information, or willingness to be trained on it properly. Pay: $18.50 - $20.50/hour Hours and Benefits: This is a full-time, fully benefited position that is eligible to receive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, as well as 401(k), PTO, and wellness incentives. Benefits add roughly 20–30% additional income to the pay range. Location (On-Site): 1952 East Fort Union Blvd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121 Requirements Must be able to work fully on-site at our Cottonwood Heights, Utah location. Desire to learn and develop technical skills. Excellent problem-solving abilities. Strong communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Additional Education or Certifications in Technology (preferred, but not required) A year or more in help desk, technical support, or a similar role. A+, Network+, or Microsoft certifications, or technical coursework. Exposure to Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, or an IT ticketing platform. Interest in scripting and automation, such as PowerShell or Power Automate.

review_candidates.title: Database Administrator
review_candidates.location: WP. Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: At Handshakes, we are committed to delivering innovative and robust cloud-based solutions that drive our business forward. We are looking for an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to join our Platforms Engineering team. In this role, you will own the health, performance, and resilience of our production database estate, working closely with Platforms Engineering and Product Engineering to keep critical data systems fast, available, and secure. This is a hands-on operations role for someone with strong DBA fundamentals who is equally comfortable navigating cloud infrastructure and troubleshooting connectivity, health checks, and system-level issues. Responsibilities: Database Performance & Optimization: Write, review, and optimize SQL queries; identify long-running or resource-intensive queries and work with engineering teams to resolve them. Reliability Operations & On-Call: Monitor database health, connectivity, and system-level metrics across production environments, participating in on-call rotation to proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users. Performance Monitoring: Run regular performance checks and capacity reviews on AWS RDS instances, using native tooling (Performance Insights, CloudWatch) to track query and resource trends over time. Database Design & Recommendations: Review database schema and query design, and propose recommendations to improve indexing, query efficiency, and overall database performance. Upgrades & Migrations: Plan and execute database version upgrades, patching, and migrations (including cross-engine or cross-environment migrations) with minimal downtime and clear rollback plans. Backup & Restoration: Own backup strategy, retention, and restoration testing across managed database services, ensuring recovery objectives (RPO/RTO) are consistently met. Infrastructure as Code: Write and maintain IaC (e.g. Terraform, CDKTF) to provision and manage database infrastructure such as RDS instances, parameter groups, and DynamoDB tables. Schema Change Management: Own version-controlled schema migrations, ensuring changes are reviewed, auditable, and reversible, with clear documentation and change records. Cost & Capacity Management: Monitor database costs and capacity utilisation, recommending right-sizing, storage autoscaling, and reserved capacity purchases where appropriate. Cloud & Systems Troubleshooting: Navigate AWS infrastructure to diagnose issues spanning networking, connectivity, IAM permissions, and compute, beyond the database layer itself. Collaboration: Work closely with Platforms Engineering, Product Engineering, and Security teams to align database operations with broader platform reliability and governance goals. Required Skills & Experience: Experience: 5–7 years of experience in a Database Administrator, Database Reliability Engineer, or similar role supporting production systems. SQL Proficiency : Strong hands-on ability to write, review, and optimise complex SQL queries across relational database engines. AWS Database Services: Deep, hands-on expertise with AWS RDS (MSSQL) — including query tuning, indexing, replication, and patching — plus working-level proficiency with DocumentDB and DynamoDB (data modeling, throughput/partition design, and troubleshooting) and S3 for backup and data storage. Comfortable ramping up quickly on an unfamiliar engine using AWS-native tooling. Performance Tuning: Demonstrated experience identifying long-running queries, tuning indexes, and improving query execution plans. Backup & Recovery: Practical experience designing and testing backup, restoration, and disaster recovery procedures for production databases. Migrations & Upgrades: Experience planning and executing database upgrades and migrations, including assessing compatibility and minimising downtime. Infrastructure as Code: Working knowledge of IaC tools (e.g. Terraform, CDKTF, or CloudFormation), with hands-on ability to write or modify code to provision database infrastructure. Schema Change Management: Familiarity with version-controlled schema migration practices, ensuring database changes are tracked, reviewed, and reversible. Cloud & Systems Fundamentals: Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure fundamentals — connectivity, networking, health checks, and basic troubleshooting — beyond the database layer. Database Design: Understanding of relational and NoSQL database design principles, with the ability to recommend schema or indexing improvements. Communication: Ability to clearly document findings, recommendations, and incident write-ups for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice-to-Have: Broader IaC experience across platform infrastructure (not limited to databases), contributing to shared Terraform/CDKTF modules. Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, or Prometheus/Grafana for database and system metrics. Familiarity with data governance, security, or compliance frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) relevant to database and data handling practices. * Work Arrangement - 3 days work in office on hybrid working as per company policy. Why Join Us: Own a critical part of the platform's reliability, with direct impact on system performance and customer experience. Work across a modern AWS-based data stack spanning relational, document, and key-value database services. Be part of a dynamic, innovative, and growth-focused engineering team. Competitive compensation, benefits, and a collaborative work environment. If you're a detail-oriented database professional who enjoys keeping critical systems fast, reliable, and well-governed, we'd love to hear from you!

Through the management and maintenance of Traffic Signals, Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS), Communications Infrastructure, Street Lighting and associated transport technology assets, Ventia supports the safe and efficient operation of transport networks. The Victorian Intelligent Transport Systems Contracts (VIMC) require the delivery of 24/7 monitoring, incident management, fault coordination, dispatch and operational reporting services to support contractual performance obligations and network availability. The Ventia Operations Centre plays a critical role in monitoring asset performance, coordinating fault response activities, managing incidents and ensuring compliance with contractual response and restoration timeframes. About The Role The Network Operations Officer is responsible for the real-time monitoring, logging, triage and coordination of alarms, faults and incidents across the Victorian Intelligent Transport Systems (VIMC) network. Working within a 24/7 Operations Centre environment, you will monitor SCATS, STREAMS, NMS and associated systems, create and manage fault records, conduct initial diagnostics, coordinate dispatch activities and provide stakeholder updates. This role is critical to ensuring incidents are accurately classified, recorded and escalated within contractual response timeframes while supporting the safe and efficient operation of Victoria's transport infrastructure network. Role Responsibilities Monitor SCATS, STREAMS, NMS and other operational alarm platforms to identify faults, incidents and service disruptions. Receive alarms, alerts, incidents and service requests and coordinate the appropriate response. Create and manage fault tickets within Maximo, MMIS and other approved systems. Conduct initial diagnostics, fault triage and escalation activities to ensure timely response and restoration. Dispatch field technicians and subcontractors while monitoring attendance and restoration progress. Maintain accurate operational records, incident logs and documentation in accordance with contractual requirements. Provide timely updates to stakeholders including DTP, TOC, Emergency Services, contractors and internal operational teams. About You Experience working within a control room, network operations centre, alarm monitoring or incident management environment. Demonstrated ability to manage alarms, faults and incidents in real time within a fast-paced operational setting. Strong administration, record management and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to work effectively within KPI and SLA-driven environments. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage a broad range of stakeholders. Experience using Maximo, MMIS or similar asset management systems is highly regarded. Knowledge of SCATS, STREAMS, Network Management Systems, ITS, telecommunications, utilities or emergency services environments is desirable. Availability to work a 24/7 rotating roster including days, afternoons, nights, weekends and public holidays. What's On Offer Permanent full-time opportunity Melbourne CBD fringe location based in Cremorne 24/7 rotating roster providing variety and operational exposure Career development opportunities within a major infrastructure services organisation Be part of a team responsible for supporting Victoria's critical transport network infrastructure About Ventia As a leading services provider, we maintain, operate, and manage the essential infrastructure that makes modern life possible across Australia and New Zealand. With more than 35,000 employees and subcontractors across 400 sites, joining Ventia means becoming part of a team that values its people, supports career growth, and helps everyone go further towards their full potential. Our commitment to Fairness, Inclusion and Respect shapes how we lead, collaborate, hire and support one another. We welcome applications from people of all ages, abilities and backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all genders, identities, sexual orientations, beliefs and caring responsibilities. We are dedicated to providing an accessible recruitment process and encourage you to request adjustments at any stage. How To Apply Click the Apply Now button to start the journey to find your further with Ventia. Position Reference Number: 168660 #VIMCjobs

review_candidates.description: About the Firm We are an established single-family office managing a diversified, multi-asset portfolio across public and private markets, now opening a new office in Hong Kong. This role is the founding hire for that office. The Role This is the founding professional hire for our new Hong Kong office. You will own fundamental Asia equity coverage within a diversified family-office portfolio and, as the firm’s sole professional on the ground, establish and manage the office’s relationships with banks, brokers, and other service providers. Working directly with the CIO, you will generate high-conviction, actionable equity ideas grounded in rigorous financial modelling, valuation, and macro and sector analysis. Your work feeds straight into Investment Committee decisions, portfolio construction, and ongoing monitoring - with a broad mandate, direct access to the principal, and real ownership of both your coverage and the office you help build. The objective is to help achieve the return targets set out in the firm’s Investment Policy Statement (IPS), within its defined risk limits. Key Responsibilities Equity research Conduct fundamental research on Asian equities, including three-statement modelling, earnings forecasts, and valuation. Track sector and thematic trends across your coverage; identify opportunities and risks. Generate clear buy / hold / sell recommendations with defined theses, catalysts, and entry and exit levels. Build and maintain financial models and a coverage database, updating assumptions as conditions change. Maintain dialogue with company management / IR and sell-side analysts to inform your views, under the guidance of the CIO. Relationship management and office representation As the firm’s sole professional in Hong Kong, establish and manage relationships with banks, brokers, and other service providers. Represent the family office in counterparty meetings and at relevant industry events, under the guidance of the CIO. Market and economic monitoring Monitor macroeconomic indicators, central-bank policy, and geopolitical developments affecting Asian equity markets. Surface emerging trends, risks, and opportunities relevant to the portfolio. Reporting and Investment Committee Produce research reports and presentations with clear conclusions - key thesis drivers, risk assessment, supporting data, and target entry / exit prices. Present recommendations to the Investment Committee and contribute to periodic portfolio reviews for the principal. Collaboration Work with the CIO and Risk Manager to integrate research into portfolio construction and risk management. Contribute to internal discussions on positioning and performance. Requirements 5–7+ years of relevant equity research experience in Hong Kong / Chinese markets - buy-side asset management, single/multi-family office, or sell-side equity research / corporate finance. Strong financial modelling and valuation skills (three-statement models, DCF, multiples). Demonstrated ability to generate actionable equity ideas that have been executed. Confident establishing and managing external relationships and representing a firm with counterparties - important for a sole-professional office. Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, or a related field; CFA (or progress toward it) preferred. Native Mandarin essential; Cantonese strongly preferred; fluent English (the investment team’s working language). Right to work in Hong Kong preferred; visa sponsorship is available for strong candidates from mainland China. No SFC licensing required - the role operates under the family-office exemption. High ethical standards, discretion, and intellectual rigor consistent with a UHNW family-office environment. Apply with CV & Cover Letter. Put "Avenor Holding Limited" in the footer of either the CV or the cover letter. Applications without this will not be considered. What We Offer Competitive base salary, a discretionary performance bonus, and a standard package of benefits. The opportunity to build out a new Hong Kong office, with a broad equity mandate, direct access to the CIO and principal, and meaningful ownership of your coverage. Relocation support available, and visa sponsorship for strong candidates. This is an equal opportunities posting.

review_candidates.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! About The Role We are looking for an IT Support Technician to provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 remote support for employees of a large technology company, assisting with software, hardware, endpoints, applications, access, and connectivity issues through ticketing, chat, email, phone, and video channels. You will triage incoming requests, resolve issues within scope, escalate appropriately while maintaining ticket ownership, and contribute to documentation, knowledge articles, and service improvement initiatives. The role is based in LatAm and requires overlap with PST business hours. What You Will Do Serve as a first point of contact for employee technical issues involving software, hardware, endpoints, systems, applications, access, and network connectivity. Provide remote support through approved channels, including ITSM workflows, chat, email, phone, and video. Effectively triage incoming requests, diagnose and resolve Tier 1 issues whenever possible, and determine the appropriate path to resolution. Own escalated tickets and subtasks through resolution or successful handoff, maintaining coordination ownership until the receiving team accepts the handoff. Perform advanced troubleshooting across software, endpoints, applications, access systems, and network connectivity using approved administrative tools and elevated access. Maintain clear, concise, and professional communication with employees throughout the support lifecycle. Log, track, and maintain complete ticket documentation, including troubleshooting performed, supporting evidence, impact, decisions, progress, and final resolution. Identify recurring issues, operational friction, and documentation gaps and contribute to service improvements and longer-term corrective actions. Create and improve knowledge articles, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and support documentation. Identify opportunities to shift appropriate work from Tier 2 to Tier 1 or self-service, as well as opportunities for automation, improved routing, and more efficient support workflows. Support technology rollouts, testing, operational initiatives, and hypercare activities as needed. Participate in assigned collaboration and support channels, queue management, quality reviews, operational reporting, and service-performance reviews. Follow all applicable service-level, security, access-control, privacy, and change-management requirements. Adapt to changes in approved processes, workflows, technologies, and support documentation while maintaining accurate and thorough documentation. Collaborate effectively with support teams, service leads, and other technical stakeholders to provide a high-quality employee support experience and continuously improve support efficiency and quality. MUST HAVES 3+ years of experience in IT Support or related roles. Proven experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 remote IT support for end-users. Strong background in diagnosing and troubleshooting common issues across software, hardware, endpoints, systems, applications, access, and network connectivity. Experience working with ITSM platforms and ticketing systems to log, track, document, and manage user interactions. Familiarity with using administrative tools and elevated access to perform authorized troubleshooting and configuration activities. Demonstrated ability to effectively triage incoming requests, resolve issues independently, or escalate them to appropriate specialist teams while maintaining ticket ownership. Ability to participate in queue management, operational reporting, and service-level compliance. Analytical skills to identify recurring problems, operational friction, and opportunities for automation or workflow improvements. Excellent customer service and professional communication skills to support employees across multiple remote channels (chat, email, phone, video, etc.). Upper-Intermediate English level. Perks And Benefits Growth without limits: build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget Competitive compensation: get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews Flexibility: work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm Meaningful, modern projects: build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands Collaborative culture: join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized Well-being & support: access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location

review_candidates.title: Database Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description BETA is a dynamic, product-based software company focused on building high-performance digital solutions for both individuals and enterprises. The company designs, develops, and launches a diverse portfolio of proprietary applications, ranging from intuitive tools for everyday users to scalable platforms for large organizations. Its products aim to simplify routines, streamline complex workflows, and deliver immediate value with an exceptional user experience. Guided by technical excellence and human-centered design, BETA creates software that is powerful, secure, and accessible. Team members collaborate in a forward-looking environment that emphasizes innovation and practical impact. Role Description The Database Specialist will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and optimizing the company’s databases to ensure reliability, performance, and security. Day-to-day tasks include administering database systems, designing and implementing data models, performing backups and recovery, and troubleshooting database-related issues. The role also involves collaborating with product and engineering teams to support application development, refine database architecture, and improve data workflows. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Tiruvallur, where the Database Specialist will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to maintain data integrity and support business growth. Qualifications Candidates should possess skills in Database Administration and Databases to manage, secure, and optimize database environments. Candidates should possess skills in Database Design and Data Modeling to architect efficient and scalable data structures. Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to diagnose issues, interpret data, and support data-driven decisions. Experience with SQL and at least one major RDBMS (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) is preferred. Knowledge of database performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimization is beneficial. Familiarity with backup, recovery, high availability, and security best practices for databases is advantageous. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to collaborate with engineering teams, document technical processes, and work effectively in an on-site environment.
